stem.text: Which statement concerning a stationary wave is correct?

A.text: All the particles between two adjacent nodes oscillate in phase.

B.text: The amplitude of the stationary wave is equal to the amplitude of one of the waves creating it.

C.text: The wavelength of the stationary wave is equal to the separation of two adjacent nodes.

D.text: There is no displacement of a particle at an antinode at any time.
